get.summary: Resume an authenticated SSE job stream
get.description: Use authenticated fetch streaming, not credentials in a query string. SSE id equals sequence; event equals type; data is one JobEvent JSON object. Heartbeats are SSE comments. Replay is bounded; an expired cursor yields 410. Cancel through the explicit endpoint; closing the stream alone does not cancel the job. Recovery sessions see only their restore job's progress/state, with no record content or inference deltas.

LocalSession.description: Short-lived unpredictable normal session established through trusted native unlock; bound to the active OS user/profile, scopes and device epoch. Never a model/provider API key.

RecoverySession.description: Distinct native-issued recovery token bound to authenticated OS user, verified recovery grant/snapshot, recovery attempt and expiry. Requires no active profile. Accepted only for new_profile restore and that attempt's restore-job read/events/cancel; cannot read ordinary records or infer. Revoked at activation, cancellation or expiry; never upgrades automatically into a normal session.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Normal sessions: scope to service-derived active profile, principal and operation. Recovery sessions: scope to authenticated OS user, verified recovery attempt and operation, without requiring a profile. Preserve across renewal/restart. Same key/body replays the prior result; different input yields 409. Retain through job completion and at least 24 hours afterward.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume after this job-local durable sequence. An expired cursor yields 410; fetch the current job and reconnect without silently inventing missed deltas.

CommonstarCommon.title: Commonstar shared contract types
CommonstarCommon.description: Closed application contracts. URNs are identifiers, not network resources.

CommonstarMemoryRecord.title: Commonstar authoritative memory record
CommonstarMemoryRecord.description: System-owned envelope. Schema validity is not authorization. A model submits a proposal, never this complete authoritative record.

CommonstarModelProposal.title: Commonstar untrusted model proposal
CommonstarModelProposal.description: No profile, permission, teacher approval, actor, retention or authoritative score fields are accepted. Local code supplies authority after semantic validation. Proposals use request-scoped labels; the local service resolves them to internal record IDs.

CommonstarContextCapsule.title: Commonstar bounded inference context
CommonstarContextCapsule.description: Only request-scoped source labels cross this boundary. Free text still requires policy checks; schema validation cannot establish anonymity.

CommonstarProviderProfile.title: Commonstar locally approved provider profile
CommonstarProviderProfile.description: Trusted configuration, not model-writable. Retention statements require operational evidence; a JSON value cannot guarantee remote behavior.

CommonstarTutorResponse.title: Commonstar tutor response shape
CommonstarTutorResponse.description: Source-label validity is checked separately. Valid labels do not prove source support or educational correctness.

CommonstarContentPack.title: Commonstar portable content pack manifest
CommonstarContentPack.description: Cryptographic signature and hash verification belong to the importer. These tests only validate structure and stated cross-references.

GrantRef.description: Opaque grant issued by trusted native setup; the service verifies purpose, session, expiry and scope. It is not a caller assertion of authority.

UrlImportRequest.description: Deliberate fetch only. Resolve/validate hosts and redirects against SSRF, private-address and policy restrictions before any connection.

score.description: Ranking score; not calibrated truth or learning probability.

TurnRequest.description: Absent provider_id means the currently explicitly selected route, initially local. The service enforces permission, context and token budgets; no automatic remote fallback.

Job.description: Progress is null when completion cannot be measured. Result exists only after validated completion. A partial model answer is never a committed memory record.

AcceptProposalRequest.description: The local service resolves request-scoped proposal references and verifies current target revisions and authority. A grant reference cannot forge teacher or custody authority.

NoteCreateRequest.description: User-authored title/body/artifact references only. Verify referenced artifacts within the active profile. The service creates record identity, profile, timestamps, revision, user provenance, review and retention; a model is not involved.

TaskChanges.description: Whitelisted user edits only. due_at and time_zone change together; null due_at removes the deadline. Goal identity, dependencies, provenance, grades and permissions are not editable here.

TaskEditRequest.description: The target must be an authorized task. Validate IANA timezone, date semantics, state transition and expected revision, then commit user provenance and reminder changes atomically. Completed means learner-reported task completion, not independently verified mastery.

CorrectionRequest.description: Corrects an authorized factual/text statement with provenance. Does not expose a generic JSON Patch, grade edit, permission edit or raw database write.

DeletionRequest.description: Records and dependent representations are handled under current authority and retention policy. A purge request is not a client override of legal retention.

PlanActivationRequest.description: plan_id is the goal record_id; expected_revision is that goal revision. The service-issued immutable preview snapshot binds the exact included task set, task/dependency revisions and dependency edges. Recompute membership and graph in the commit transaction; any addition, removal or revision/edge change yields 409 and requires fresh preview. Validate an IANA time zone and commit acceptance/reminders atomically.

PlanPreview.description: Authorized read-only preview of a goal and exact current task graph. The short-lived snapshot grant adds no privilege and is bound to the active principal/profile, goal, graph and expiry. The service retains or authenticates the full immutable snapshot; the client cannot substitute returned JSON as trusted proof.

ReceiptList.description: Every item has record_type receipt. Only the authenticated session's permitted receipts are returned.

BackupRequest.description: Uses the one already configured approved backup destination. No arbitrary destination URL or raw key is accepted.

RestoreRequest.description: A trusted native grant binds selected snapshot, unlock method and any overwrite confirmation. A recovery-scoped session needs no active profile, but may use only mode=new_profile with its bound grant/snapshot and expected_active_epoch=null. Replacement requires a normal active-profile session. Validate in isolated storage; profile identity comes from verified recovery metadata. Activation revokes recovery access and requires fresh normal authentication.

ExportRequest.description: Selected-record exports require a nonempty authorized record_ids list. Whole-profile scope is restricted to the active session and a matching disclosure grant. This operation creates a disclosed additional encrypted copy.

ProviderPairRequest.description: References locally established pairing evidence. The service revalidates peer identity, transport/app credentials, policy, age conditions and capability checks. The request cannot assert approval with a Boolean or submit a trusted provider-profile object.

DeltaEvent.description: Untrusted display-only partial text; never an accepted memory write.

x-commonstar-recovery-session-policy.issued_by: Trusted native recovery flow after OS-user and recovery-grant verification
x-commonstar-recovery-session-policy.activation: Revoke recovery token and require fresh ordinary profile authentication
x-commonstar-recovery-session-policy.response_scope: Restore progress/state only; no record contents, inference deltas, raw keys or cross-profile metadata

x-commonstar-security-invariants: No caller-selected profile_id field or cross-profile request routing.
Resolve normal objects/grants against the active-profile session; recovery access is limited to its verified attempt and never selects an arbitrary profile.
All mutations require Idempotency-Key and current revision where applicable.
Revalidate grants, peer identity, age/policy and retention at use; schemas cannot establish authorization.
Strict Host/Origin checks, no permissive CORS, no query-string credentials, no remote listener.
No raw encryption keys, raw provider secrets, arbitrary filesystem paths, shell or SQL in the API.
Response and SSE payloads use Cache-Control no-store; log only minimized operational metadata.
Normal tokens are invalidated on vault lock, session switch and device-epoch revocation; recovery tokens expire or revoke on activation/cancellation.
A recovery token cannot invoke search, records, notes, tasks, receipts, inference, export or provider pairing.
plan_id equals goal.record_id; activation atomically validates goal revision and exact included task/dependency snapshot.
